issue.title: [Bug]: git_operations tool only run git command under workspace, not any subdirectories even I asked to

steps: Create a directory named project_path in the workspace, run `git init project_path`, create project_path/README.md containing `hello`, and commit it inside project_path with the message `init`.
expected: git_operations runs `git status` inside the project_path subdirectory and reports its (clean) repository status.
defect: git_operations always runs git in the workspace root, so it reports that there is no git repository ("Not in a git repository") instead of the status of project_path.

fault location.explanation: Always runs git with current_dir(&self.workspace_dir); PR #4483 (commit ac543cf) passes a resolved working_dir instead.
The tool schema has no way to name a subdirectory; PR #4483 adds an optional `path` parameter (resolved and confined to the workspace by resolve_working_dir).

Checks for .git only at the workspace root and its parents and fails with 'Not in a git repository' when the repo lives in a subdirectory; PR #4483 performs the check on the resolved working directory.

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/pull/4483 (commit https://github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/commit/ac543cff20efcf58761cef9ea3c7aa8dfe481ced, "fix(tools): allow git_operations to run in workspace subdirectories", "Fixes #4409"). In v0.5.9 GitOperationsTool has no parameter for a working directory: execute looks for .git at the workspace root (and its parents) and run_git_command always spawns git with current_dir(&self.workspace_dir). When the repository is in workspace/project_path and the workspace root is not a repository, every git_operations call fails with "Not in a git repository" (or reports the wrong repository), which is what the reporter saw until they told the agent to use the shell instead. The fix adds an optional `path` argument, resolve_working_dir (canonicalises it and rejects paths outside the workspace) and threads the resulting working_dir through every git sub-operation. The fix first ships in v0.6.1 and is an ancestor of the pinned v0.8.5, so the pinned revision contains it.
